entities.summary: Orhan Aydın Hacıyev is an Azerbaijani professional basketball player for iLab Basketbol of the Türkiye Basketbol Ligi. He plays the power forward position. He is 2.03 m tall. He is member of Azerbaijan national basketball team. He also holds a Turkish citizenship.
